Plots high resolution classification plot

plot_hires.Rd

Plot the result of color classification analysis in high resolution in a linear form.

Usage

plot_hires(hires_params, interactive = FALSE)

Arguments

hires_params

data.frame with hires results, calculate using calculate_hires.

interactive

...

Value

a girafe object.

See also

calculate_hires

Examples

kin_dat <- prepare_kin_dat(alpha_dat)
fit_k_params <- get_example_fit_k_params()
control <- get_example_control()
fit_values <- create_fit_dataset(kin_dat, control = control, fit_k_params = fit_k_params)
hires_params <- calculate_hires(fit_values, method = "weighted")
plot_hires(hires_params)
